title: GDPR compliance
body:
What are the plans for GDPR compliance for decidim? I assume this would include:

- collecting logs of all activities
- forget users info
- provide users UI to see all your personal info (comments, votes, ideas)
- etc.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: Hi @joonasp! We have some issues tagged as [`privacy`](https://github.com/decidim/decidim/labels/team%3A%20privacy) that might guide you, but I guess people from @decidim/product will be able to help you more than me :)

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body:
hi @joonasp sorry for the late response, I had a number of issues that past my tracking and I am currently coming back to them. 

We are waiting for a detailed assessment of the changes we need to have to comply with GDPR, if you have a list that is more detailed than what you have included as bullet-point is will certainly help.

For Decidim it is difficult to asses what is "personal info" since we only store hashing of minimal personal information, and what I got as a result of asking some experts is that hashes don't constitute personal information (but I would like a second opinion on this). 

As @mrcasals says there are some issues tagged with `privacy` but these are more focused on ethical and political aspects than complying directly with the GDPR directive. 

At Barcelona City Council we are undergoing a widespread effort to comply with GDPR and I am still waiting for a specific set of recommendations. Lets turn back to this issue as soon as I get feedback.

comments.author: Participant 4
comments.body:
Hey @xabier , 

This becoming a hot topic as the deadline is getting closer. Would have time for a call in the following week so we can talk how best Decidim can be GDPR compliant ?

comments.author: Participant 5
comments.body:
Hi all! Sorry for the delay with this subject. Just so you know, on Barcelona City Council there is a consultant that is studying the new regulation and is making us a report on changes that we should make to be GDPR compliant. We hope to receive an answer on the next couple of weeks regarding this subject. 
On the other hand, if you have any feature that you know for sure that we should make, please let us know.

comments.author: Participant 5
comments.body:
Hi all! 
Just an update with this issue, we're going to tackle this features [with these issues](https://gist.github.com/andreslucena/ac9799d15af451ad774fa89fedf17516). Please review and give feedback.

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: great work @andreslucena please @joonasp @virgile-dev review this. Also, this issue has been introduced as a feature proposal at meta.decidim: https://meta.decidim.barcelona/processes/roadmap/f/122/proposals/12416?locale=en

comments.author: Participant 5
comments.body: Hi all! We're going to close this issue on favour of #3320 so we can better discuss each one of the changes.

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
